players.product: Nuclear / gas / battery power generation + powered-land deals for AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: The earnings release states the additional 920 MW of long-term nuclear PPAs signed with investment-grade customers are 15-20 years in duration and set to begin in 2029 through 2032 (the presentation says contracts begin 2029-2031 and are fully ramped by 2032). Among them, a 176 MW agreement with Walmart will enable a 30 MW capacity expansion at the Dresden Clean Energy Center in Illinois. The presentation also says the fleet is positioned to add ~1,100 MWs of uprates, including previously announced uprates and 900 MWs of uprates possible with customer support.
quarterly_data.figure: 920 MW of PPAs, 15-20 years; begin 2029 through 2032 (release) / begin 2029-2031, fully ramped by 2032 (presentation); 176 MW Walmart agreement enabling a 30 MW Dresden expansion; ~1,100 MWs of uprates
